title: BerkePvpClient
description: This project adds a dynamic HUD overlay that displays your real-time armor durability and player health. All numerical values are automatically color-coded to instantly reflect how much health or durability you have remaining.
body:
# BerkePvPClient

A lightweight, highly functional HUD utility mod designed specifically for Fabric 1.21.11.

## 🛡️ Core Features

This mod provides a clean and intuitive on-screen overlay so you never have to second-guess your vital stats during combat, exploration, or intense encounters.

* **Dynamic Armor Durability:** Displays the exact numerical durability of your currently equipped armor (helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots) directly on your screen.
* **Real-Time Health Tracking:** Keeps your current player health clearly visible at all times.
* **Color-Coded Status Alerts:** All numerical values dynamically shift colors based on your current health and armor condition. Numbers will start green when your gear is highly durable and you are healthy, and will dynamically change colors as your armor degrades or you take damage, giving you an immediate visual warning.

## ⚔️ Why use this mod?

Instead of constantly opening your inventory to check the tiny durability bars on your gear, this mod puts the exact numbers right in front of you. It is designed to be unobtrusive but highly informative, ensuring you know exactly when it is time to repair your gear or retreat from a fight.
